lessons.title: Introducing CSS Grid 🕸️
lessons.description: Understand the two‑dimensional layout system, the container‑item relationship, and grid terminology.

lessons.title: Defining the Grid: Columns & Rows 📏
lessons.description: Create explicit grid tracks with `grid-template-columns`, `grid-template-rows`, the `fr` unit, `repeat()`, and `minmax()`.

lessons.title: Placing Grid Items 🧩
lessons.description: Position items on the grid using line numbers, `span`, named lines, and the `grid-area` shorthand.

lessons.title: Gaps & Spacing 🕳️
lessons.description: Set consistent gutters between grid tracks with `gap`, `row-gap`, and `column-gap`.

lessons.title: Alignment in Grid 🎯
lessons.description: Align items and tracks using `justify-items`, `align-items`, `justify-content`, `align-content`, and their place shorthands.

lessons.title: Grid Template Areas 🗺️
lessons.description: Design layouts visually with named areas and the `grid-template-areas` property.
